mutations.because: The D227 census must name every category it answers, and `templates` is one of the thirteen named keys (pg-only, so its literal answer is the shared `PG_ONLY` line). Deleting that one line costs the census its thirteenth name: `Object.keys(census).sort()` comes back twelve and the test asserting the sorted thirteen names fails. No other test in the file this lane runs can see it — every other census test asserts counts of categories whose answers come from the walk, not from the `PG_ONLY` constant — which is exactly why the `-t` pattern names the thirteen-keys test and not the file.
